-- ============================================================================
-- INCR 전용 수집 스크립트 : pl_raw_orch_incr > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script"
--   흐름 : Ins_master_run(PENDING) -> Set Variable(pv_incr_from_val) -> 이 Script
--          -> Filter Not Skipped -> ForEach -> pl_dispatcher_ingest
--          실패 시 Fail_master_run, ForEach 완료 시 End_master_run (adf_script_v83_master_end.sql)
--
--   대상   : Run Group(p_run_group_nm, job_type_cd = RAW_INCR) 의 INCR 대상 (vw_ingest_exec_target)
--            p_target_ids 로 일부만 수동 실행 가능 (예: [1001,1002])
--   증분 조건 : 증분컬럼 >= 시작일  (시작일 = pv_incr_from_val, 모든 대상 공통)
--     pv_incr_from_val : ADF Set Variable. 파라미터 p_incr_from_val 이 있으면 그 값, 없으면 오늘 - N 일
--                        형식 yyyy-MM-dd 또는 yyyyMMdd
--     증분컬럼 유형 (master.incr_column_type) · 형식 (master.incr_column_format)
--       DATE      DB2 : col >= DATE('2026-10-01')             MSSQL : CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)
--                 기타 : col >= DATE '2026-10-01'
--       TIMESTAMP DB2 : col >= TIMESTAMP('2026-10-01 00:00:00') MSSQL : CAST('2026-10-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME2)
--                 기타 : col >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
--       STRING  + 형식 : col >= '20261001'  (시작일을 형식대로 변환. YYYYMMDD / YYYY-MM-DD / YYYYMM ...)
--       NUMERIC + 형식 : col >= 20261001    (숫자형 날짜. 따옴표 없음)
--       형식은 PostgreSQL to_char 형식 (YYYY MM DD HH24 MI SS)
--     상한 · HWM 사용 안 함 (incr_to_val = NULL)
--
--   DBX 전달 (GEN2)
--     load_method_cd = master.incr_load_method_cd (UPSERT / RANGE_DELETE_INSERT ...)
--     RANGE_DELETE_INSERT : range_column_nm = 증분컬럼, range_operator_cd = '>=',
--                           range_value = ["YYYYMMDD"] (월 형식 컬럼은 ["YYYYMM"])
--
--   CDC / 경로 / 파일명 : FULL 스크립트와 동일
--     추출 위치 = COALESCE(NULLIF(cdc_tgt_*, ''), src_*), 파일명 = src_*
--     landing_path 없으면 incr/batch_date=YYYYMMDD/batch_hour=HH/pipeline_name={자식 파이프라인명}
--     file_nm_template 없으면 {src_db}.{src_schema}.{src_table}.{YYYYMMDDHHMISS}.parquet
--
--   즉시 실패 (형변환 오류로 Script 실패 -> 실패 경로에서 Master FAILED)
--     시작일 없음 / 형식 오류          -> INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:값
--     STRING / NUMERIC 인데 형식 없음  -> INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:target_id
--     그 외 유형                       -> INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:target_id
--
--   Script 재시도 = 0. ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용
-- ============================================================================
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text                     AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}', '')::jsonb          AS target_ids,
           trim('@{variables('pv_incr_from_val')}')                            AS from_in,     -- yyyy-MM-dd / yyyyMMdd
           '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text                           AS batch_str,
           '@{if(pipeline().globalParameters.gp_pipeline_run_skip, 'Y', 'N')}'::text AS skip_yn,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                                   AS created_by
),
-- ⓪ 시작일 검증 · 변환
d AS (
    SELECT p.*,
           CASE WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN to_date(p.from_in, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{8}$'                  THEN to_date(p.from_in, 'YYYYMMDD')
                ELSE to_date(('INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:' || p.from_in)::int::text, 'YYYY')
           END AS from_dt
      FROM p
),
-- ① 대상 + 추출 위치
t0 AS (
    SELECT e.run_group_id, e.run_rule_id, m.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),     m.src_db_nm)     AS ext_db_nm,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), m.src_schema_nm) AS ext_schema_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(m.landing_path), '')     AS landing_path_in,
           NULLIF(trim(m.file_nm_template), '') AS file_nm_template_in
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target    e ON e.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm AND e.run_type_cd = 'INCR'
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = e.target_id
     WHERE p.target_ids IS NULL
        OR e.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.target_ids)::bigint)
),
-- ② 조건 · 자식 파이프라인명 · 경로 · 파일명
t AS (
    SELECT t0.*, x.pl_nm,
           -- 기록용 시작값 : 증분컬럼 형식 (DATE / TIMESTAMP 는 YYYY-MM-DD)
           CASE WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) IN ('STRING','NUMERIC') AND NULLIF(trim(t0.incr_column_format), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN to_char(d.from_dt, t0.incr_column_format)
                ELSE to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS from_val,
           -- DBX 범위 값 : 월 형식(일 없음) 컬럼은 YYYYMM, 그 외 YYYYMMDD
           CASE WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) IN ('STRING','NUMERIC') AND t0.incr_column_format NOT ILIKE '%DD%'
                THEN to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYYMM') ELSE to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') END AS range_val,
           t0.incr_column_nm || ' >= ' ||
           CASE upper(t0.incr_column_type)
             WHEN 'DATE' THEN
                  CASE upper(t0.src_type)
                    WHEN 'DB2'   THEN 'DATE('''  || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ''')'
                    WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN 'CAST('''  || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ''' AS DATE)'
                    ELSE              'DATE '''  || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '''' END
             WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN
                  CASE upper(t0.src_type)
                    WHEN 'DB2'   THEN 'TIMESTAMP(''' || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00'')'
                    WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN 'CAST('''      || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00'' AS DATETIME2)'
                    ELSE              'TIMESTAMP ''' || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00''' END
             -- 문자 · 숫자형 날짜 : 형식대로 변환
             WHEN 'STRING' THEN
                  CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t0.incr_column_format), '') IS NULL
                       THEN ('INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:' || t0.target_id)::int::text
                       ELSE '''' || to_char(d.from_dt, t0.incr_column_format) || '''' END
             WHEN 'NUMERIC' THEN
                  CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t0.incr_column_format), '') IS NULL
                       THEN ('INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:' || t0.target_id)::int::text
                       ELSE to_char(d.from_dt, t0.incr_column_format) END
             -- 그 외 유형 -> 형변환 오류로 Script 실패
             ELSE ('INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:' || t0.target_id)::int::text
           END AS cond_sql,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.landing_path_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(t0.landing_path_in,
                        '{batch_date}',  left(d.batch_str, 8)),
                        '{batch_hour}',  substr(d.batch_str, 9, 2)),
                        '{pipeline_nm}', x.pl_nm)
                ELSE 'incr'
                     || '/batch_date='    || left(d.batch_str, 8)
                     || '/batch_hour='    || substr(d.batch_str, 9, 2)
                     || '/pipeline_name=' || x.pl_nm
           END AS landing_path_out,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.file_nm_template_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(t0.file_nm_template_in,
                        '{src_db}', t0.src_db_nm), '{schema}', t0.src_schema_nm), '{table}', t0.src_table_nm),
                        '{part}', ''), '{ts}', d.batch_str)
                ELSE t0.src_db_nm || '.' || t0.src_schema_nm || '.' || t0.src_table_nm
                     || '.' || d.batch_str || '.parquet'
           END AS file_name_out
      FROM t0 CROSS JOIN d
      -- 자식 파이프라인명 : pl_{data_class}_ingest_{src_type}_{추출 DB}  예) pl_raw_ingest_db2_MLCRP
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 'pl_' || lower(t0.data_class) || '_ingest_' || lower(t0.src_type)
                                 || '_' || upper(t0.ext_db_nm) AS pl_nm) x
),
-- ③ Master 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING (+ 대상 건수)
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
       SET status = 'RUNNING', start_dt = now(), update_dt = now(),
           child_total_cnt = (SELECT count(*) FROM t)
      FROM p
     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'
    RETURNING m.master_run_id
),
-- ④ 수집 이력 PENDING / SKIPPED 생성
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, run_group_id, run_rule_id, target_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, run_type_cd,
           sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, range_column_nm, range_operator_cd, range_value,
           incr_policy_id, incr_column_nm, incr_from_val, incr_to_val,
           src_type, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, data_class,
           extract_query, landing_path, file_name, sink_table_full_nm, status, created_by)
    SELECT p.master_run_id, t.run_group_id, t.run_rule_id, t.target_id, t.pl_nm, 'INCR',
           t.sink_type_cd,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' THEN t.incr_load_method_cd END,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT' THEN t.incr_column_nm END,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT' THEN '>=' END,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN jsonb_build_array(t.range_val) END,
           t.incr_policy_id, t.incr_column_nm, t.from_val, NULL,
           t.src_type, t.src_db_nm, t.src_schema_nm, t.src_table_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''), NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), t.data_class,
           -- 추출쿼리 : 템플릿 우선({WHERE} -> 증분 조건), 없으면 SELECT * (추출 위치 스키마)
           CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t.src_query_template), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(t.src_query_template, '{WHERE}', t.cond_sql)
                ELSE 'SELECT * FROM ' || t.ext_schema_nm || '.' || t.src_table_nm
                     || CASE WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'MSSQL' THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)' ELSE '' END
                     || ' WHERE ' || t.cond_sql
                     || CASE WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'DB2'   THEN ' WITH UR'       ELSE '' END
           END,
           t.landing_path_out,
           t.file_name_out,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'TABLE' THEN concat_ws('.', t.sink_db_nm, t.sink_schema_nm, t.sink_table_nm) END,
           CASE p.skip_yn WHEN 'Y' THEN 'SKIPPED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,
           p.created_by
      FROM t CROSS JOIN p
    RETURNING ingest_pipeline_id, master_run_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, extract_query, landing_path, file_name,
              sink_table_full_nm, target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm,
              cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, sink_type_cd, load_method_cd,
              incr_column_nm, incr_from_val, range_value, status
)
-- ⑤ ForEach 입력. Filter Not Skipped : @not(equals(item().status, 'SKIPPED'))
SELECT ingest_pipeline_id,                                  -- p_ingest_pipeline_id
       master_run_id,                                       -- p_master_run_id
       ingest_pipeline_nm,                                  -- p_child_pipeline_nm
       extract_query,                                       -- p_extract_query
       COALESCE(landing_path, '')       AS landing_path,    -- p_landing_path (TABLE Sink 는 '')
       COALESCE(file_name, '')          AS file_name,       -- p_file_name    (TABLE Sink 는 '')
       COALESCE(sink_table_full_nm, '') AS sink_table_full_nm,
       target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
       sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, incr_column_nm, incr_from_val, range_value::text AS range_value, status
  FROM ins
 ORDER BY target_id;

@if(
    empty(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.p_incr_from_val, '')),
    formatDateTime(
        addDays(convertFromUtc(utcNow(), 'Korea Standard Time'),
                mul(-1, int(variables('pv_condition_interval')))),
        'yyyy-MM-dd'),
    pipeline().parameters.p_incr_from_val
)

-- ============================================================================
-- pl_raw_orch_incr > Script "Ins_master_run" (INCR 수집 첫 활동)
--   ctl_master_pipeline_run 에 이번 실행을 PENDING 으로 등록
--     -> Set Variable (pv_incr_from_val)
--     -> Start_ingest_pipeline Script (adf_script_v83_incr.sql : 수집 이력 생성 + Master RUNNING 전환)
--     -> Filter -> ForEach -> End_master_run (SUCCEEDED / FAILED)
--        Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 시 Fail_master_run (adf_script_v83_master_end.sql)
--
--   진입 구분 : 그룹에 스케줄이 있고 수동 실행(Manual)이 아니면 SCHEDULE, 그 외 MANUAL
--   그룹명이 틀리거나, 비활성이거나, INCR 그룹(RAW_INCR)이 아니면 행이 만들어지지 않고 에러
--   같은 RunId 재실행 시 무시 (ON CONFLICT)
--   run_param : 수동 지정값 기록 (target_ids, incr_from_val = 파라미터 p_incr_from_val)
--   선행 : ck_master_status 에 PENDING 추가 (adf_meta_alter_v83_cdc_tgt.sql)
-- ============================================================================
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                  AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().Pipeline}'::text                                AS pipeline_nm,
           '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text               AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}', '')::jsonb    AS target_ids,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_incr_from_val}'), '')  AS incr_from_val,
           '@{pipeline().TriggerType}'::text                             AS trigger_type,   -- Manual / ScheduleTrigger / PipelineActivity ...
           '@{pipeline().TriggerName}'::text                             AS trigger_nm,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                             AS created_by
),
g AS (
    SELECT p.*, g.run_group_id, g.schedule_id,
           (g.schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND p.trigger_type <> 'Manual') AS sch_yn
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
        ON g.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
       AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y'
       AND g.job_type_cd = 'RAW_INCR'                       -- INCR 전용 마스터
),
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, master_pipeline_nm, trigger_type_cd, adf_trigger_nm, schedule_id, run_group_id,
           run_param, status, created_by)
    SELECT g.master_run_id, g.pipeline_nm,
           CASE WHEN g.sch_yn THEN 'SCHEDULE' ELSE 'MANUAL' END,
           NULLIF(g.trigger_nm, ''),
           CASE WHEN g.sch_yn THEN g.schedule_id END,
           g.run_group_id,
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('target_ids',    g.target_ids,
                                                'incr_from_val', g.incr_from_val)),
           'PENDING',
           g.created_by
      FROM g
    ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING master_run_id, trigger_type_cd, schedule_id, run_group_id, run_param, status
)
SELECT i.master_run_id, i.trigger_type_cd, i.schedule_id, i.run_group_id, i.run_param::text AS run_param, i.status,
       -- 그룹명 오류 · 비활성 · INCR 그룹 아님 -> 형변환 오류로 활동 실패 (메시지에 그룹명 표시)
       CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM g) = 0
            THEN ('RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_INCR:' || (SELECT run_group_nm FROM p))::int
            ELSE 1 END AS chk
  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN ins i ON TRUE;
